conditions: females only, wild-caught flying beetles (Los Tuxtlas, Veracruz, Mexico) and laboratory-reared females (3 generations on Platanus mexicana sawdust medium); about 108 +/- 18 individuals per origin over three occasions (about 12 +/- 2 beetles per bark ageing period); the text reports test statistics and amplitudes appear only in a figure; the sentence covers both species; EAG responses differed between wild and laboratory-reared X. ferrugineus to ethanol (laboratory-reared higher); among bark odours the strongest were B. simaruba at 48 h in X. affinis and P. schiedeana at 24 and 48 h in X. ferrugineus per the Abstract; ethanol served as the positive control, so this compares a standard against bark headspace, not a dose series
